title: Typing speed test with WPM and accuracy
when: The user wants a typing test that measures words per minute and accuracy over a timed passage.
prompt:
Goal: Honest WPM and accuracy with clear per character feedback that works with any keyboard, including mobile.
Steps:
1. Passages in a local array; render each character as a span built with createElement to mark correct, wrong and current.
2. Capture text in a labeled input or textarea, not document keydown, so mobile keyboards and composition work; the timer starts at the first character.
3. logic.mjs: compare(target, typed) per char states, wpm = correct chars / 5 / minutes, rawWpm, accuracy = correct / typed.
4. Modes 30 s, 60 s or full passage; time left shown, result announced in aria-live at the end.
5. Results: WPM, accuracy, errors; best per mode in localStorage guarded; Restart button and Escape.
6. Ignore pasted text and say so.
7. test.mjs: wpm with a fixed elapsed time, accuracy after corrections, extra characters.
Quality bar:
- Current character is obvious.
- Errors shown with color plus underline.
- No layout shift while typing.
Pitfalls:
- Timing from the page load.
- Counting backspaced characters as errors forever with no raw versus net split.
- Keydown capture that breaks accented input.
Verify:
- [ ] Input labeled.
- [ ] Results live.
- [ ] Math tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (scoring), test.mjs.

examples.output: 60 s passage, green and red letters, 52 WPM, 96 percent accuracy
